title: SG-6.4.3 · Wire approve, retry and reject handlers into AdminApp's ExecutionPanel
summary: AdminApp passes onApprove, onRetry and onReject to ExecutionPanel, reloads after each action and shows failures.
description: Context: ExecutionPanel already accepts onApprove, onRetry, onReject and actionError, and api/client.ts already exports approveExecution, retryExecution and rejectExecution. AdminApp.tsx renders ExecutionPanel with only execution and contributionCount. Desired behavior: each handler calls the matching client function for the current execution, reloads the data, and shows an error on failure. Expected result: admin can approve, retry or reject from the panel. Why: finish SG-6.4 wiring.
acceptance_criteria: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Approve or Reject is clicked, then the matching POST is sent with the bearer token and the data reloads
Given a FAILED execution, when Retry is clicked, then the retry POST is sent and the data reloads
Given an action fails with a non-401 error, when it completes, then the panel shows the message or 'Request failed' and a 401 returns to the token gate
technical_constraints: tsc --noEmit must pass with no duplicate declarations
Reuse existing client functions and ExecutionPanel props
definition_of_done: Unit tests with mocked fetch pass
